name: @tvlm/desktop
description: Electron shell for Windows / macOS / Linux: the web bundle in the renderer, Tango in the Node main process (USB + TCP), one installer per brand.

scripts.dist:launcher: pnpm --filter @tvlm/web run build:launcher && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher pnpm build:main && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @tvlm/web run build:launcher && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher pnpm build:main && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @tvlm/web run build:launcher && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher pnpm build:main && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac
scripts.pack:launcher: pnpm --filter @tvlm/web run build:launcher && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher pnpm build:main && cross-env TVLM_BRAND=launcher electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --dir
